title: Personal Care Sample and Tester Workflows: Track Requests Through Warehouse Fulfillment
summary: A tester request raised in HubSpot resolves to approved sample items in NetSuite, ships through Extensiv, and reports the shipped assortment back to sales.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


Treat sample and tester requests as approved allocations with their own item and recipient context. A personal-care workflow should verify the salon or retailer, distinguish testers from retail goods, and report actual fulfillment back to sales. Confirm the warehouse actions before using them; a CRM request is not a warehouse shipment.


Explore the complete[personal care integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/cpg/personal-care) for the systems and processes around this guide.
